title: Sky Control: Air Traffic Collision Avoidance
instructions: Touch and drag airplanes to draw flight vector paths. Adjust flight levels (FL100, FL200, FL300) to separate traffic in 3D and guide flights to runway landings.
description: Sky Control is a tactical top-down air traffic control simulation puzzle game. Direct jetliners, supersonic concordes, and medevac helicopters safely through high-density airspaces without collisions.

faqs.q: How do I avoid collisions between planes?
faqs.a: You can either drag a new flight path to turn the plane away, or change its altitude level (FL100, FL200, FL300). Planes at different altitudes can safely pass over one another.
Draw a path leading directly into the runway's approach zone, or select the aircraft and tap the LAND button when near the airport at FL100.

faqs.q: Does it work on mobile touchscreens?
faqs.a: Yes, Sky Control is fully optimized for smartphones and tablets with smooth 60 FPS touch vector drawing.
